extra_snippets: An AI-powered distributed power generation platform, AGent Energy announced the completion of an $11 million Series Seed funding round co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures. New participation came from Intrepid Investment Management, with continued investment from existing investors CIV and Zero Infinity Partners (ZIP).

The company has raised $7.9 million in pre-seed funding led by Cerberus Ventures, with New System Ventures (NSV) involved as an incubation investor, and support from investors including Scout Ventures, Alumni Ventures, Lightscape Partners, and CLAI, as well as the U.S. Department of Energy's 'Genesis Mission' program.

It is reportedly one of the fastest-funded companies in the distributed energy resources sector to date. The U.S. power grid is facing increasing strain; the most recent capacity auction by PJM (a regional transmission organization in the eastern U.S.) cleared at the price cap without securing enough capacity to meet demand, and the increase in load from AI data centers is said to be outpacing the pace of new supply in every major market. AGent Energy focuses on backup power generation equipment already installed at commercial and industrial facilities, including AI data centers, and provides technology to aggregate, control, and monetize these assets via an AI platform, turning them into rapidly deployable and highly reliable distributed power plants.
